about.title: About The Project
about.description: Learn about OpenThrone and its development.
about.originStory: OpenThrone is a persistent strategy game inspired by the spirit of DarkThrone, with kingdom building, army management, and strategic combat.
about.modernStack: OpenThrone began as a fork of Moppler’s Dark Curse project. DasTacoMann has since developed it on a modern Next.js and React stack.
about.notAffiliated: OpenThrone is not affiliated with nor endorsed by the original DarkThrone project or its creators.
about.serverStatus: The game is currently in active development. The server you are playing on is a Live Development Server.
about.mayReset: The game may be reset often, sometimes without notice.
about.featuresAdded: Features are being added and balanced daily.
about.basicMechanics: We are focused on getting basic mechanics functioning perfectly.
about.faqIsGameStillBeingDeveloped: Is the game still being developed?
about.faqActive: Yes. OpenThrone is actively developed by DasTacoMann and operated by AIOXperts IT Solutions LLC.
about.faqHelp: Report bugs through the issue tracker or contact us on Discord. Include what happened, what you expected, and steps to reproduce the problem.
about.howCanIHelp: How can I report a problem?
about.faqIdeas: You can submit suggestions through the issue tracker. Suggestions are reviewed alongside development priorities; not every suggestion will be implemented.
about.shareIdeasGitHub: You can submit suggestions through the issue tracker. Suggestions are reviewed alongside development priorities; not every suggestion will be implemented.
about.licensed: OpenThrone is licensed under MIT License. Copyright © 2023.
about.developmentInfo: OpenThrone is developed by DasTacoMann and operated by AIOXperts IT Solutions LLC, which funds its development and provides hosting.

offer.title: Take the first-turn tour?
offer.body: A short optional walkthrough will point out the menu, advisor, stats, Training, Armory, Bank, and leave you on Attack.

menu.title: The command menu
menu.body: Use this bar to move between Home, Battle, Structures, Alliances, and the wider realm.

sidebar.title: Your kingdom ledger
sidebar.body: The sidebar keeps gold, citizens, level, turns, the advisor, player search, and the turn timer close at hand.

overview.title: Read the realm at a glance
overview.body: Overview is the pulse check: wealth, population, army size, banked gold, and progress toward the next level.

training.title: Train citizens with intent
training.body: Workers create gold, offensive units win attacks, defensive units protect your people, and spy roles control information.

armory.title: Equip before you march
armory.body: The Armory turns trained units into real power. Buy offense to hit harder and defense to hold your ground.

bank.title: Bank what you cannot defend
bank.body: Gold in hand is useful but exposed. Deposits protect wealth while workers and structures keep income moving.

attack.title: Choose your first target
attack.body: You are ready to scout the battlefield. Compare levels, gold, and risk before spending attack turns.
